g.text: BIR: streaming multi-scale backbone and bounded neuron
Existing backbone retained. Seven state groups; one update per 50 ms window.
The tensor has 2 count channels + 5 temporal bins x 2 polarities. Report-change savings and dense GPU runtime are distinct metrics.
